name: Y'shtola, Night's Blessed
oracle_text:
Vigilance
At the beginning of each end step, if a player lost 4 or more life this turn, you draw a card.
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell with mana value 3 or greater, Y'shtola deals 2 damage to each opponent and you gain 2 life.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of each end step, if a player lost 4 or more life this turn, you draw a card.

needs.what: a value that reads the most life any ONE of the named players lost this turn, e.g. {"max_life_lost_this_turn": "each_player"}, so an intervening-if trigger condition can say "if a player lost 4 or more life this turn" as {"cmp": ">=", "left": {"max_life_lost_this_turn": "each_player"}, "right": {"const": 4}} -- the life-loss twin of the existing max_damage_taken_this_turn
needs.why_existing_wont_do: life_lost_this_turn sums over every player its spec names (values.py), so with each_player or each_opponent it is true when two players lost 2 each, which the card does not mean; max_damage_taken_this_turn is per-player but counts damage, not life loss (payments, drain effects); a condition has no per-player quantifier, and hard-coding seat ids into a max list or flagging inside for_each_player would be an approximation
